error-handling.evidence: FOUND+FIXED (LOW): on an otherwise-current repo with an existing CODEOWNERS, nothingToDo was true (action!=add) so the no-clobber advisory was swallowed behind "already current", misleading a user who asked for coverage. Fixed: nothingToDo now requires codeownersAction===none; two tests added (advisory-not-swallowed + empty-owner blocker). Injection/no-clobber/fail-closed all verified safe.
